title: nassella charruana
intro: Nassella charruana, commonly known as Queñua or Andean wheat grass, is a type of grass native to the Andean region of South America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Nassella charruana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Nassella charruana work synergistically to provide its therapeutic benefits, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
